name: HEY Agenda
author: Josh Fabean
description: The Omarchy calendar with your HEY agenda under it: a daily agenda you can expand to the week, and a bar icon when something is close.

barWidget.description: The stock date/time label, with a calendar icon when something is close, and a calendar popup carrying your HEY agenda.

schema.label: Show the calendar icon this many minutes ahead
schema.description: The icon appears this long before an event starts and stays until it ends. 0 turns it off. All-day events never trigger it.

schema.label: Bar date format
schema.description: Qt date format, same as the stock Clock widget. Right-click the widget to cycle presets.

schema.label: Dim events that have already ended
